## Public projects
- [Vibrix](https://github.com/mixutin/Vibrix): An independent Rust operating system. From UEFI to an interactive kernel console, with a persistent USB-first future. Kernel console works in QEMU. Persistent USB storage and general userspace remain in development.
- [Lumina](https://github.com/mixutin/Lumina): A Steam-free Linux home for the official Zenless Zone Zero launcher. Built around HoYoPlay and UMU/Proton. Launcher architecture and interface are under development; not a stable daily-driver release.
- [Mallow](https://github.com/mixutin/Mallow): A native Apple Silicon project working toward Windows app compatibility, with careful runtime setup and integrity checks. The preview installs and verifies Wine. It does not run Windows programs yet.
- [Dauntless Revived](https://github.com/mixutin/dauntless-revived): Keeping a game alive through reverse engineering and a self-hosted backend. A modified fork of Undaunted. Based on Undaunted by gwog and contributors (AGPL-3.0). Unofficial; no game files are distributed.
- [JKI / Jake](https://github.com/mixutin/JKI): A voice-controlled desktop companion for Codex, combining local speech recognition, spoken replies and a GTK interface. Speech is transcribed locally; commands are sent to Codex. The wake word is not speaker authentication.

CryptoHack: #1 globally and #1 in Finland, owner-supplied September 2026 portfolio snapshot, not a live or independently verified ranking. Current profile: https://cryptohack.org/user/nurminen/
